judge: The agent successfully opened TeamChat #design and read the feedback, opened CloudDocs and edited the Mobile Launch Plan, opened CloudSlides and edited the Conference Practice Deck slide, and set a 15-minute timer in Clock. However, the timer criterion is partially problematic - looking at the screenshots, the timer was set to 15:00 and started (Step 26 shows 'Pause' button indicating it was running). The CloudDocs update was visible in screenshot 9 showing the text was added. The CloudSlides update was visible in screenshot 17 showing 'Updated per design feedback: new search empty-state illustration, spacing fixed, accessibility passed - Benchmark...' in the subtitle. However, the timer was set to 15 minutes but the agent's final answer claims it was set correctly. The main issue is that the timer appears to have been set correctly at 15 minutes and started. The CloudDocs document shows the edit was made (screenshot 9). The CloudSlides shows the edit (screenshot 17). The feedback was correctly read from the thread. However, looking more carefully at the final state (screenshot 28), it shows the CloudDocs document without the design feedback text visible - it may not have been saved properly, or the view is showing the top of the document. The edit was made in step 9 and saved in step 10. The final screenshot 28 shows the document without the added text visible, but this could be because the text was added lower in the document. Overall, most criteria were met but the timer was only set to 15 minutes (not confirmed as 15 minutes in the final answer - the agent said it was set). The key failure is that the timer was set correctly but the agent's answer about the timer being set is confirmed by screenshot 26 showing 'Pause' button.
